review: Independent Scripture and fidelity pass over Scherer [1]–[28] against the locked DCO/Scherer Greek. Quotation wording in the English follows the dump, not a modern critical NT when they differ.

added_scripture_references.note: Locked Greek has χωρὶς Θεοῦ ('apart from God'), the famous variant against χάριτι Θεοῦ. Kept.

remaining_textual_uncertainty.note: † τῷ ἀχράντῳ in the 'one God' / Isaiah-Deuteronomy block; left as [lacuna].
τοὺς τηροῦντες / ἐμποιοῦντες after τούς: likely accusative participles, not emended.
DCO [00079] heavily daggered (αν †, ουτ †, και ναι †). Covenant-penalty clause rendered as [lacuna], not reconstructed. Confidence uncertain for that stretch.
† ειπεναι at the Maximus address; † in the double-mind clause.
1 Thess 5:23 printed in two slightly disordered forms; both translated as present.
ἔσηνεν (ὅσα ἔσηνεν ἡμᾶς) uncertain; rendered 'have been indicated'.
1 Cor 6:9-10 list in the dump is shorter than the usual Pauline list; omitted members not supplied.
† ὅτι ὡς πρὸς Θεόν in the Celer anecdote; ellipsis after φρονήσωμεν.
† ὄντος τοῦ Θεοῦ in the image argument.
κέωνται likely κεῖνται; <ἄτοπόν> is an editor supplement already in the dump.
ἀπελύθη Ἀαρών: exact OT wording uncertain (possible Num 20:26-28); marked possible.
Scherer [26] not a lost page: DCO prints ἀπο26 θνῄσκει. Recovered, disclosed.
Heb 2:9 χωρὶς Θεοῦ is Origen's reading here; crux kept. Jer 1:5 first clause doubled in the dump; both copies kept.
[ὁρῶμεν] editor restoration not treated as certain Origen. No Amen in the dump.

cruxes.decision: Translate 'apart from God'. This is how Origen answers 1 Tim 6:16 (God alone has immortality): the Son died, the Father did not. Do not substitute χάριτι Θεοῦ.
Not missing text. Unbracketed 26 inside ἀποθνῄσκει.
